title: Dinosaur dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Dinosaur dancing: green body, brighter green belly, orange spikes, blue shoes -->
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M32 72 Q18 72 12 60 Q20 66 24 62 Q16 70 28 78 Z' fill='#3ecf6a'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <rect x='38' y='72' width='12' height='18' rx='5' fill='#2fae57'/>
  <!-- shoe back -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='92' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#3b6fe0'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='89' rx='9' ry='3' fill='#6f9bff'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='62' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#3ecf6a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='66' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#a8f0bd'/>
  <!-- front leg (raised, dancing) -->
  <rect x='62' y='64' width='11' height='16' rx='5' fill='#2fae57' transform='rotate(28 67 70)'/>
  <!-- front shoe raised -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='62' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#3b6fe0' transform='rotate(28 74 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='59' rx='8' ry='3' fill='#6f9bff' transform='rotate(28 74 59)'/>
  <!-- arm waving up -->
  <path d='M62 48 Q74 40 78 26' stroke='#2fae57' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- little hand claws -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='25' r='3' fill='#a8f0bd'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M38 46 L42 36 L46 46 Z' fill='#ff9f2e'/>
  <path d='M48 42 L52 31 L56 42 Z' fill='#ff9f2e'/>
  <path d='M58 44 L62 34 L66 44 Z' fill='#ff9f2e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='36' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#3ecf6a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='40' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#3ecf6a'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='46' r='3' fill='#ff8db0'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='33' r='1.8' fill='#1a3a8a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M70 44 Q74 48 79 44' stroke='#2fae57' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='37' r='1.4' fill='#2fae57'/>
  <!-- little dancing sparkles -->
  <path d='M24 30 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 Z' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <path d='M86 74 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 Z' fill='#ffe14d'/>
</svg>
